A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], the '''mother''' of a boy named [[Durrei]], lived on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. Shortly after [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]], she was accused of [[Treason/Legends|treason]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. When her [[Durrei's father|husband]] resisted, they were both [[Death/Legends|executed]].
